articleTitle: Hydrating Dry Skin Without Heavy Occlusives: 5 Alternatives to Slugging
imageHeadline: Hate slugging? Hydrate without the grease
imageSubtext: Five occlusive alternatives for dry skin that won't wreck your pillowcase
pinTitle: Dry Skin Hydration Without Slugging: 5 Lighter Occlusive Alternatives
pinDescription: Slugging isn't for everyone—especially if you wake up stuck to your pillowcase. Discover five research-backed alternatives that seal in moisture without heavy petroleum jelly, tailored for arid climates and anyone who wants effective hydration minus the mess.
